cancelReason.description: Present only on a CANCELLED wave.

costPerStopCents.description: The declared marginal cost of ONE delivery stop on this wave, integer cents (ADR 0011). 0 until declared and for a declared zero alike.

gCo2ePerStop.description: The declared marginal greenhouse emission of ONE delivery stop on this wave, in grams of CO2 equivalent (ADR 0016). 0 until declared and for a declared zero alike.

400.description: The request is malformed at the HTTP level. Problem types `idempotency-key-required` (no Idempotency-Key header), `idempotency-key-invalid` (not 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters), `invalid-limit`, `invalid-cursor`, `unknown-query-parameter`. `invalid-limit` is a limit outside 1 to 500, empty or repeated; `invalid-cursor` a cursor that is not a page token or is repeated.

404.description: The wave, route, partner or (for an attempt) the package on the route does not exist, or the path matches no route or holds a NUL character. Problem types `not-found`, `package-not-on-route`, `resource-not-found`.

409.description: Conflict with the aggregate's state or capacity. Problem types: `illegal-transition`, `concurrent-update`, `route-over-capacity`, `route-not-started`, `already-delivered`, `attempt-already-recorded`, `package-not-inducted`, `package-already-routed`, `stop-key-mismatch`, `partner-inactive`, `partner-station-mismatch`, `route-incomplete`. `idempotency-key-reused` (the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different method, path or body). ErrWaveFull (`wave-full`), ErrInductionClosed (`induction-closed`) and ErrAlreadyInducted (`already-inducted`) are raised only by policy-driven induction, which has no route.
